rationale: Each register is written only by its own generate-instance flop and x0 is a constant, so every storage element has exactly one clocked writer.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Reduced to the 32-entry base register file with one write port, dropping the CHERIoT, dummy-instruction and RV32E variants.

labels.note: Every register word and both read outputs have defined drivers.
